caption: The drawing on a light beige background presents three detailed renderings of an ornate, decorative object that appears to be a metal trivet or stand. The largest illustration occupies the center-right of the page, oriented at an angle, and showcases elaborate scrollwork, twisted rope-like borders, and a symmetrical pattern radiating from a central starburst-motif. To the upper left, a top-down view of the same object displays the same intricate details with symmetry visibly emphasized. Below this view, there is a straightforward side elevation that shows the object’s thickness and how it is elevated by two supporting legs. To the left of the side elevation is a small scale bar, marked in feet and inches. All details are rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite, with shading to indicate depth and texture. In the lower left corner, the name "Filippo Pericca" is written in cursive. There are some small brown marks on the upper right edge of the paper.
title: Flat Iron Holder
